propositions: Under sync --only (primary route), run_differs hands the planner a selection with LOCAL IDS only, causing _scope_excluded to classify bound-issue updates (with jira-key targets) as out-of-scope and defer them instead of planning them as mutate.

Because bound-issue updates are deferred, the live coordinator skips them and the write is dropped, leaving the remote value unchanged and triggering perpetual re-emission and empty renderedFields on the next pass.
The legacy --filter-local-ids route works correctly because _build_filter_target_set expands selection to LOCAL IDS ∪ BOUND JIRA KEYS, allowing jira-key-targeted updates to match in-scope.

The fix expands selection_ids in run_differs via a pure helper _scoped_selection_ids to include bound jira keys, restoring parity with the legacy route and ensuring bound-issue updates are planned as mutate and executed by the coordinator.

The root cause is a latent scope-check defect (commit 85f8) that became a live write drop when commit 67d4 made the coordinator+fuse reroute the authoritative dispatch path without ensuring in-scope bound-issue updates classify as mutate.
The same id-expansion also corrects a latent --except case where an excepted bound ticket's jira-key-targeted update was not being excluded.
